lede: The Gold Mountain Fire — nearly 40,000 acres burned northeast of Ouray, Highway 550 severed repeatedly, communities cut off — lands squarely on the agenda Wednesday when Ridgway Town Council meets to ratify its backing of a federal Major Disaster Declaration. Also Wednesday, the San Miguel County BOCC holds a special meeting to consider a resolution adjusting AMI limits on deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park, which is the kind of technical-sounding item that actually determines who qualifies for affordable housing. Thursday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire recovery.
